assets.name: short-video-apricot
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: existing homepage card illustration, color-only art direction revision. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Recolor this exact illustration to a distinct warm apricot, soft terracotta and creamy ivory palette. Change the large lavender backdrop to a light peach-apricot solid backdrop (#f7e3d3 family), the purple microphone and phone frame to soft muted terracotta / warm peach, and the film strip to warm brown; keep subtle champagne-gold metallic details naturally gold, cream play triangle creamy ivory, sunset warm peach and mountain landscape muted earthy slate / sage. Flowers can be warm dried florals. Maintain original relative object positions, exact subjects, camera framing, 3:2 landscape aspect ratio, all geometry, intricate mesh and paper-clay watercolor texture, soft shadows and quiet premium feel. This should clearly read as an APRICOT card when placed next to a mint-teal card and a lilac card. Keep soft low saturation, but sufficiently colored for instant differentiation. Change ONLY the color palette and related lighting tint; do not add/remove/move/crop objects. No text, no letters, no UI, no border, no watermark.
